ledger.sentence: Triptans are medicines for treating migraine attacks, and sumatriptan is the triptan covered on this site.
ledger.note: Migraine Trust triptans page title; NHS sumatriptan page

ledger.sentence: The NHS says sumatriptan relieves symptoms of migraine but does not prevent migraines from starting.
The NHS says migraine symptoms may be caused by a temporary widening of blood vessels in the head, and sumatriptan is believed to reduce this widening.
Heart problems, a past stroke or transient ischaemic attack, circulation problems in the legs and liver disease are listed by the NHS as reasons sumatriptan may not be suitable.
Combining sumatriptan with some antidepressants or St John's wort can cause serotonin syndrome, according to the NHS and UK leaflets.
